title: Exterior waves, absorbing boundaries and PML

items.title: Cartesian complex-stretch PML for a homogeneous Helmholtz mode
items.statement: Fix k>0 and a Cartesian normal coordinate x. Let sigma(x)>=0 be piecewise C^1, vanish at and before the physical/PML interface x=0, and set X(x)=x+i integral_0^x sigma(s) ds with stretch derivative s(x)=1+i sigma(x). The pulled-back constant-coefficient Helmholtz operator is (1/s) partial_x((1/s) partial_x)+Delta_y+k^2. The definition is only for this Cartesian homogeneous branch.

items.title: First-order local impedance condition at an artificial plane
items.statement: With the outgoing convention exp(i q x) and outward normal +x, the first-order local impedance boundary condition on an artificial plane x=R is partial_x u-i k u=0. It is a local approximation to the exact outgoing relation; no exactness at oblique incidence is part of the definition.

items.title: Perfect matching and attenuation for non-grazing propagating modes
items.statement: For a tangential Fourier mode with |eta|<k, choose the outgoing normal branch q=sqrt(k^2-|eta|^2)>0. Then u=exp(i q X(x)+i eta dot y) solves the stretched Helmholtz equation, agrees with the physical outgoing mode with matching normal flux at x=0, and has modulus exp(-q S(x)), where S(x)=integral_0^x sigma. Uniform exponential decay holds only under an explicit lower bound q>=q0>0.

items.title: Spherical Hankel modulus and uniform radial bounds
items.statement: For l>=0 and real z>0, |h_l^(1)(z)|^2=sum_{m=0}^l S_lm z^(-2m-2), where S_lm=(2m)!(l+m)!/(4^m(m!)^2(l-m)!). Consequently |h_l(z)| is nonincreasing in z, |h_(l-1)(z)|<=|h_l(z)|, and |h_l'(z)|<= (1+(l+1)/z)|h_l(z). For fixed z0>0 and every z>=z0, |z(h_l'(z)-i h_l(z))|/|h_l(z0)| <= (l+1) exp(2 z0).

items.title: Exact plane-wave reflection coefficient of the local impedance condition
items.statement: For a homogeneous propagating mode exp(i q x+i eta dot y)+R exp(-i q x+i eta dot y), with 0<q<=k and q^2+|eta|^2=k^2, the condition partial_x u-i k u=0 gives R=(q-k)/(q+k). Thus |R|=(k-q)/(k+q), which vanishes at normal incidence and tends to one at grazing incidence.

items.title: Exact reflected-mode error from a finite Dirichlet-terminated PML
items.statement: For a layer 0<=x<=L with S(L)>0, a propagating mode q>0, and a homogeneous Dirichlet condition at x=L, the reflected amplitude at the physical/PML interface is B/A=-exp(2 i q X(L)); its magnitude is exp(-2q S(L)). This is the exact continuous one-mode truncation error.

items.title: Exact modal Dirichlet-to-Neumann map on a sphere
items.statement: For R>0 and smooth g on S_R, write its spherical harmonic coefficients as g_l. Define T_(k,R)g by the modal multiplier tau_l=k h_l^(1)'(kR)/h_l^(1)(kR): T_(k,R)g=sum_l tau_l g_l. The outgoing extension is v(r,omega)=sum_l h_l^(1)(kr)/h_l^(1)(kR) g_l(omega), with the convergence and exactness claims proved separately.

items.title: Exact spherical-mode reflection under the local impedance truncation
items.statement:
Fix $k,R>0$ and $\ell\ge0$. On $r=R$, write one radial mode as $u(r)=A h_\ell^{(1)}(kr)+B h_\ell^{(2)}(kr)$, where $h_\ell^{(2)}=\overline{h_\ell^{(1)}}$. If $u$ satisfies $\partial_ru-iku=0$ at $R$, then
$$B=-\frac{(h_\ell^{(1)})'(kR)-ih_\ell^{(1)}(kR)}{(h_\ell^{(2)})'(kR)-ih_\ell^{(2)}(kR)}A.$$
The denominator is nonzero. For $A\ne0$, the exact reflected modal-amplitude ratio is therefore
$$\frac BA=-\frac{(h_\ell^{(1)})'(kR)-ih_\ell^{(1)}(kR)}{(h_\ell^{(2)})'(kR)-ih_\ell^{(2)}(kR)}.$$
If $A=0$, the coefficient equality forces $B=0$ and no ratio is defined. No uniform-in-$\ell$ smallness is asserted.

items.title: Rellich uniqueness for the sound-soft spherical obstacle
items.statement: For k>0 and a>0, a classical outgoing solution of (Delta+k^2)u=0 on |x|>a with zero Dirichlet trace on |x|=a is identically zero. The proof uses the imaginary Green flux identity on concentric spheres and the outgoing modal expansion.

items.title: The spherical modal DtN map is well-defined and exact for smooth data
items.statement: For every smooth g on S_R the defining DtN series converges to a smooth boundary function, the outgoing extension series converges in H^1 on each bounded exterior annulus, and its radial derivative at r=R equals T_(k,R)g. The extension solves the exterior Helmholtz equation and satisfies the uniform outgoing Sommerfeld condition.

items.title: Exact-DtN truncated modal variational formulation
items.statement: For 0<a<R define the spherical coefficient energy space on the annulus a<r<R by the sum of radial H^1 and angular eigenmode energies. Given f in C^infinity(S^2), the trial trace is f at r=a. The exact-DtN variational equation is the sesquilinear Helmholtz energy form on the annulus minus R^2 times the pairing of T_(k,R)u(R) with the test trace at r=R, tested against functions with zero trace at r=a.

items.title: Modal trace bound and continuity of the exact-DtN variational form
items.statement: On every fixed annulus 0<a<R, the inner and outer modal traces satisfy a weighted one-dimensional trace inequality. The spherical energy form and the exact-DtN boundary pairing are finite and continuous on the defined coefficient energy space.

items.title: Existence and uniqueness for the spherical exact-DtN variational problem
items.statement: For every 0<a<R, k>0, and smooth Dirichlet datum f on the inner sphere, the exact-DtN modal variational problem has a solution in the stated coefficient energy space, given by the outgoing spherical modal series, and that solution is unique.

title: Exterior waves, absorbing boundaries and PML — Examples

items.title: The outgoing monopole field of a sound-soft sphere
items.statement: For constant boundary data f=1 on radius a, the outgoing mode l=0 gives u(r)=h_0^(1)(kr)/h_0^(1)(ka)=(a/r)exp(ik(r-a)). It satisfies the PDE, the unit Dirichlet trace, and the outgoing condition.

items.title: PML attenuation vanishes at grazing and excludes evanescent modes
items.statement: For q=k cos(theta)>0 the one-way PML amplitude after integrated stretch S is exp(-k S cos(theta)); this is exp(-kS) at normal incidence and tends to one as theta approaches grazing. A purely evanescent normal branch q=i alpha has no additional modulus decay under this imaginary-coordinate stretch.

items.title: Normal, oblique, and grazing impedance reflection
items.statement: For q=k cos(theta), the exact reflected amplitude is (cos(theta)-1)/(cos(theta)+1). It is zero at theta=0, equals -1/3 at theta=pi/3, and tends to -1 as theta approaches pi/2.

items.title: A weakly damped truncated layer can produce a resonant cavity response
items.statement: Consider the one-dimensional stretched interval with Dirichlet endpoints, total stretched length X(L)=L+iS, and a point source at x=L/2 before the PML begins. At kL=(2m+1)pi its Green function at the source has magnitude coth(kS)/k, which grows like 1/(k^2 S) as S decreases to zero; at S=0 the real-frequency problem has a nontrivial homogeneous mode.

items.title: The monopole symbol of the exact spherical DtN map
items.statement: For degree zero, h_0^(1)(z)=-i exp(iz)/z, so the exact spherical DtN multiplier is tau_0=k h_0'(kR)/h_0(kR)=ik-1/R.
